items.summary: ## Security Patch Release 5.2.1 is a patch release on top of 5.2.0 with security fixes and bug fixes. items.title: axe-core · Release 4.14.1
items.summary: This patch release contains only bug fixes. Most of them remove false positives, so issue counts will mostly go down: empty-table-header, link-in-text-block, target-size and aria-valid-attr-value (fewer "needs review" results for aria-controls). Two changes can add new issues: - meta-viewport-scale now reports invalid `user-scalable` and `maximum-scale` values. - Elements with `position: absolute` and `fixed` are now placed correctly when axe works out what is on top of what. This can change color-contrast and target-size results in either direction. heading-order now lists the previous heading as a related node; issue counts don't change. If you use `axe.runVirtualRule`, the `after` steps of checks now run, so those results now match `axe.run`. ### Bug Fixes - **aria-valid-attr-value:** don't review aria-controls when the popup exists ([#5408](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core/issues/5408)) ([cfd2ea6](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core/commit/cfd2ea6004e681a97eaca8bedd3add1c721

Easily restrict which actions agents can do autonomously and use our brand new “Human in the Loop” mode that let agents propose risky changes (like publishing to production) that a human must review and approve in the UI before it is applied. items.summary: GrowthBook 5.1 includes over 400 commits touching almost every part of the product. Below are some of the highlights. ## Highlights **Contextual Bandits (beta)** - One size doesn’t fit all. Contextual Bandits let you run personalization experiments to find the best performing variant for each group of users. The bandit continuously learns and updates weights as it runs and helps you pick out the signal from the noise. **Saved Learnings** - Document deeper learnings about your users that you’ve discovered through experimentation.
